about: Akan (Twi). First drafts moved from voice/intents.js. Never sent until a Twi speaker checks them.

voice.reply.emergency.text: Eyi betumi ayɛ ahohia. Kɔ ayaresabea a ɛbɛn wo ho nnɛ. Sɛ wontumi nantew a, frɛ wo CHW anaa ahohia nɔma nnɛ.
voice.reply.emergency.source: This may be an emergency. Go to the nearest health facility now. If you cannot travel, call your CHW or the emergency number right away.
voice.reply.emergency.translator: first draft in the repository (author not recorded)
voice.reply.emergency.note: Says nnɛ (today) where the English says now; see docs/CODE_REVIEW_2026-11-07.md.

voice.reply.visit_date.text: Wo clinic nsɔhwɛ a edi hɔ no yɛ da a wo CHW kyerɛɛ wo. Sɛ wonnim da no a, bisa wo CHW.
voice.reply.visit_date.source: Your next clinic visit is on the date your CHW gave you. Please come. If you do not know the date, ask your CHW.
voice.reply.visit_date.translator: first draft in the repository (author not recorded)

voice.reply.transport.text: Sɛ akwantu yɛ ɔhaw a, ka kyerɛ wo CHW. Wo CHW betumi aboa wo ma wonhyehyɛ akwantu.
voice.reply.transport.source: If transport is a problem, tell your CHW. Your CHW can help you plan a ride to the facility.
voice.reply.transport.translator: first draft in the repository (author not recorded)

voice.reply.feeding.text: Sɛ w'abisa nneɛma a wɔde bɛma abofra no ho a, wo CHW bɛboa wo. Bisa no sɛ ɔnkyerɛ wo nnuane a wɔapene so.
voice.reply.feeding.source: For feeding questions, your CHW will help. Ask them to show you an approved feeding plan for your baby.
voice.reply.feeding.translator: first draft in the repository (author not recorded)

voice.reply.unknown.text: Me ho ayɛ wo, minnte nea woka no. Frɛ wo CHW, anaa ka sɛ obi nfrɛ wɔn ma wo.
voice.reply.unknown.source: Sorry, I did not understand. Please call your CHW, or ask a family member to call them for you.
voice.reply.unknown.translator: first draft in the repository (author not recorded)
